review_kind: Independent complete-body source review only of five new geometry-authored modules
findings: Every new body read in full against literal plan.selected, uColumn, complement, exactSVD, threshold and orthonormalMember definitions.

Selected frame uses literal list lookup; actual selected list is nodup and SVD column orthogonality supplies frameGram=I. Complement is exactly residualProjection mulVec; self-adjointness/idempotence refer to the actual map.

Positive SVD columns agree only for positive singular values. Weighted-entry identity covers zero directions without constraining arbitrary zero-axis bases; actual PSD reconstruction uses the actual U.
Finite selected-list sum is transported exactly to its strict-threshold mask. Full-U Gram and cogram identities provide the same actual masks and residual spectral values.

Residual singular value at every unselected index is at most the literal nonnegative square-root threshold. Congruence proves threshold I-H leverage H PSD and its actual complement quadratic form. This stronger claim needs no accuracy or basis-independence premise.

Residual basis blocks are actual H times supplied Gram-Schmidt outputs. Their Gram sum equals H leverage H exactly; actual K/H row splitting and zero cross terms give Frobenius and coefficient Gram splitting.

Independent is used only where needed for actual normalized basis inner products, residual-basis norm<=1 and coefficientGram K+H=I. Each coefficient Gram is PSD by actual flattened Gram representation.
authorship_scope: New five sources only. Root-authored prerequisite proofs are excluded from independent-authorship claim.
